clips.title: The story
paras: Frosthowl is a quest in Dun Morogh tasking adventurers with recovering a stolen sack of fish from a thieving wendigo. The beast ambushed a local dwarven fisher and fled into the depths of the Grizzled Den.

Ice fishing across the freezing waters of Dun Morogh is grueling, bitter labor. A dwarven fisher and her husband, Paxton, spent days out on the frozen lake braving biting winds just to harvest a single sack of fish. Their hard work was abruptly undone when Frosthowl, a menacing and thunderous wendigo, ambushed the camp and made off with their entire haul into the snowy wilderness.

Frosthowl is not just an ordinary scavenger; the beast is notorious for its booming roars that rattle the ice and scare off the lake's sparse fish. After snatching the fisher's supply sack, the drooling creature retreated deep into the dark tunnels of the Grizzled Den to the southeast, leaving the stranded fishers desperate for someone to confront the monster and retrieve their stolen goods.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.

Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.
Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bear tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.
